title: Hatsune Miku — Featuring Hello Kitty〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Kitty! What's that big tree over there?

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: In Puroland, we call it the Wisdom Tree.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: It's where we sing, dance and hold parades for all our friends who come to visit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, so that's why there's a stage at the bottom!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Speaking of friends, where did everybody go?
Come on everyone! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Was that just...!
se_run_men_002_1
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait for us, Pochacco!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Rin, Len!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Purin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku! You're here too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We've made some new friends!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Your name is Miku, right? I'm Purin!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: Nice to meet you! I'm Pochacco! We've been exploring around the Wisdom Tree with Rin and Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Purin, Pochacco, it's lovely to meet you both! Thank you for being so kind to Rin and Len!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: We were just looking for everyone! Have you seen Melody, Kuromi and Cinnamon?

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Cinnamon's on that bench over there♪

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Teehee, you're great at giving scritches, Luka. I'm so cozy I might doze off right here in your lap...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, you can sleep if you want. Your ears are so soft and fluffy, they're so nice to pet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka's here too! Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO and KAITO are right over there!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: And then, I gave out the cookies I baked with Grandma to all of my friends. Except, there weren't enough left for Kuromi...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
So I said, “It's okay, you can have my cookie!”
And then, Kuromi split the cookie in half and shared it with me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My, what a lovely friendship you two have!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: That darn My Mel! She's always so selfish.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: First she offers me her cookie...

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: ...but then when I try to take a bite she just keeps sighing over and over, like she wanted to eat it so badly! How could I possibly eat it when she's acting like that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, so that's why you gave her half.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: What else could I do?! And on top of that, I couldn't break it evenly, so My Mel ended up with a bigger piece than me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. You're very good to your friends, aren't you, Kuromi?

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: F-Friends?! Far from it! She's my ultimate rival! I can't stand losing to her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really? You would do something kind like that for your rival?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's really sweet of you, Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: K-KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: You're a good judge of character, huh?! Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Everyone's become such good friends!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I want to make friends with everyone just like Rin and the others have.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Don't worry, Miku♪ I'm sure you can make friends with them right away!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Hey everybody! There's someone I'd like you to meet!

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: So your name is Miku? Teehee, let's be friends!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: My name is My Melody♪ Lovely to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: The name's Kuromi!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: If there's anything you need to know about this place, just gimme a shout!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: But Kuromi, when we were trying to figure out what this place is, you said, “I don't know. Let's stop talking about it.”

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Hm? I don't remember that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you all explain that this is a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We did! But we weren't sure what kind of feelings it actually came from.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why we've been exploring with Pochacco and everyone to see what kind of SEKAI this is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We've all only just arrived here as well, so we've been chatting to try and get to know each other.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So we're still not sure what feelings could have created this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Although, this place is nearly identical to Puroland, so I think there must be some connection there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Perhaps this SEKAI was born from the fun and enjoyment all the people who visited Puroland experienced.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And maybe it also looks like Sanrio Puroland because of the people who wished they could come back to visit again.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line:
So this place was made from people's feelings...
But why all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmmm. Maybe because some exciting event took place in the real world?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But that would mean...
Once the event is over, this SEKAI will return to a fragment?!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: What will happen when it returns to a fragment?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It means we won't be able to play or hang out here anymore, and you and everyone else will be sent back to Puro Village.

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: What?! I thought we were gonna get to explore!

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: I wanna keep adventuring!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. I don't think this place will be disappearing any time soon.

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: But it will someday, right?! And then we'll have to say goodbye to you and everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: It is sad...

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: But I think getting to meet Miku and all of you...

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: ...and learning how this SEKAI came to be is truly incredible.

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Because it means so many people created wonderful memories at Puroland, that an adorable SEKAI like this could be born!

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: And knowing that makes me feel so happy!

rows.Speaker: Pochacco
rows.Line: So, we were able to meet Len and everyone thanks to all the people who came to visit Puroland?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Instead of worrying about when the fun will end, let's think of how to enjoy our time together now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah! And since this SEKAI is built from fragments of feelings, it's possible more people might be drawn here by their emotions.

rows.Speaker: Pompompurin
rows.Line: That means we can make even more friends! Yaaay!

rows.Speaker: KUROMI
rows.Line: Sure, that's what you think. But I kinda like where your head's at.

rows.Speaker: Cinnamoroll
rows.Line: Yeah yeah♪ We should have fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Kitty!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that we're all together, do you think you could teach us one of your songs?

rows.Speaker: Hello Kitty
rows.Line: Of course! Let's practice on that stage over there♪
